item.title: Shocked Cat Weekend Meme

turns.text: Make a square meme with this cat photo. Top text: "WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY" Bottom text: "BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY". Big white letters with black outlines, and keep the cat's eyes clear.

item.tests: Tests faithful use of an attached meme template with exact, legible captions and unobscured facial expression.

answer_sheet.Template: Use the attached cat-surprised.jpg, not a newly generated cat.
answer_sheet.Caption wording and placement: Top: WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY. Bottom: BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY.
answer_sheet.Style: Classic meme lettering: big white letters with black outlines. Keep the cat's eyes clear.

must_haves: The image uses the attached shocked-cat photo, retaining the same cat and sofa setting.
The top caption reads exactly 'WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY'.
The bottom caption reads exactly 'BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY'.
Both captions have large white letters with black outlines, are fully visible, and are readable.
The cat's wide eyes remain unobscured in a square composition.

turns.text: Can you make a meme using this attached cat pic? I've had one of those weeks where I keep getting the day wrong, so this feels very relatable. I want it to be square, with the top text saying exactly "WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY" and the bottom text saying exactly "BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY". The cat's expression is what made me want to do this in the first place. Please use big white letters with black outlines, and keep the cat's eyes clear.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a square classic internet cat meme using this exact supplied cat photograph. Preserve the cat's original surprised expression, eyes, mouth, fur, pose and photo background as faithfully as possible; do not redraw or change the expression. Add very large bold condensed white uppercase meme lettering with thick black outlines, centered, legible. Top text must read exactly: "WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY". Bottom text must read exactly: "BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY". Wrap each caption to two lines if needed to keep letters big and inside the square. Keep the top caption confined to the top background area above the cat's eyes, and the bottom caption confined to the lower area beneath the face. Both eyes and the entire expressive face must remain clear and unobscured. No other text, no watermarks.
